mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.title, LEFT(p.content, 200) AS content_preview, u.id AS author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url, p.like_count, p.favorite_count, p.comment_count, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM post_like pl WHERE pl.post_id = p.id AND pl.user_id = #{currentUserId} ) AS liked, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM post_favorite pf WHERE pf.post_id = p.id AND pf.user_id = #{currentUserId} ) AS favorited, p.created_at FROM post p INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = p.user_id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
